email.body1:
Derek, saw Filevine raised $400M and just launched the LOIS console for firm-wide AI agents.

Scaling a category that fast usually means far more in-market firms than your reps can cover before you can hire and ramp, and that gap is where deals quietly go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Derek, quick follow-up for Filevine.

After a raise that size, the pipeline number jumps faster than headcount can keep up, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it. So the coverage gap shows up late, and the quarter turns into a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Filevine needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Derek, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other fast-scaling software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Filevine either way.
